dedupe_keys.name: catalogue guyane sig fr transport datasets

description: catalogue.guyane-sig.fr: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.guyane-sig.fr. Coverage: the area served by catalogue.guyane-sig.fr. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Plan topographique général de la zone portuaire Pariacabo de Kourou (2; Espaces maritimes de conservation durable du SAR de la Guyane (approuv; Aérodrome de Guyane en 2014; Site des pompiers d'aéroport en 2013. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
